verdict.rationale: Render documents an official CLI for managing services and datastores from the terminal and for validating render.yaml Blueprints. Nothing in the evidence shows a single CLI command that scaffolds a new project and deploys it. The MCP server's trigger_deploy tool only redeploys an existing service and is not the CLI, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command
